name: BridgePRS
model_likelihood: Independent locus-wise Gaussian trait models, parameterized by precision
prior: Discovery-informed Gaussian prior for target-population locus effects
inference_algorithm: Conjugate updates with ridge combination of target-only and two-stage scores
estimand: Marginal-likelihood-weighted combination of three candidate PRSs
data_input: Discovery and target GWAS summaries and individual-level tuning datasets in both populations
tunable_settings: Stage-1 alpha and lambda0 grids; locus inclusion k; stage-2 tau grid; cross-validated ridge penalties

name: BridgePRS stage 1: single-population PRS
prior: Zero-centered conjugate Gaussian SNP-effect prior with SNP-specific shrinkage
estimand: Ridge-weighted combination of locus-summed posterior-mean scores across grids
data_input: Single-population GWAS summaries and test genotype-phenotype data
tunable_settings: alpha in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}; lambda0 in {0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5}; k=1..8; cross-validated ridge penalty

name: BridgePRS stage 2: discovery-informed target PRS
prior: Optimized discovery posterior used as a prior, with precision scaled by tau
estimand: Ridge-weighted locus-summed target posterior-mean scores across tau and inclusion thresholds
data_input: Stage-1 discovery effects, target GWAS summaries and target genotype-phenotype tuning data
tunable_settings: tau in {1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500}; stage-1 locus thresholds; cross-validated ridge penalty
